info.title: ACC local API
info.description: Access to an ACC workspace in the ACC Data Contract format. Off by default; every request needs `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (Settings → Data contract & API). Reads are GET; the only write is staging a file for a person to review (POST /api/v1/staged-imports), which is a separate switch.

post.summary: Send a contract file for review (staged, never applied automatically)
post.description: For tools such as a Glean action. Requires the API and 'send data for review' to be on. The file waits in Settings → Data contract & API until a person applies or discards it. Max 5 MB, 60 files an hour.
